audit.whatIsWrong: Content named Naafiri's W 'The Hunt' in five fields — the real name is Hounds' Pursuit; tldr/winCon referenced a 'silence' Lux does not have; dosFull[2].d claimed a 'fifteen-second invitation' — Light Binding is 10s flat; cooldowns field had no numbers; Illumination's auto-attack-reset burst tell unmentioned.
audit.why: Lux Q 10s flat, E Lucent Singularity 10-8s, W barrier 12-10s, Final Spark 60/50/40s. Her burst detonation is an auto-reset off Illumination — the wind-up after a landed spell is the cue. All three of her damage spells are projectiles/skillshots minions and packmates can eat.
audit.corrected: Names, numbers, and the reset tell written in; silence phrasing replaced.

edits.before: Lux is a skillshot mage with no dash, so once you have W The Hunt plus Q charges you dictate every trade. Bait her Q Light Binding by walking side-to-side behind minions, and the moment it whiffs step up with Q daggers and threaten W. Her E Lucent Singularity is her only zoning tool without Q up, so a dodged binding means she's defenceless for the next 9-11 seconds.
